strings.name: Tory Burch
strings.role: Fashion designer; executive chairman and chief creative officer of her namesake brand
strings.summary: Tory Burch founded her namesake fashion brand in 2004, expanding from a New York boutique and e-commerce into clothing, footwear and accessories. She is its executive chairman and chief creative officer and established a foundation in 2009 to give women entrepreneurs access to finance, education and business resources.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Brand founder, executive chairman and CEO are distinguished, as are succession announcements and effective dates, and foundation aims and demonstrated results. Birth date relies on a secondary biographical report.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded her namesake fashion brand and a foundation supporting women entrepreneurs through access to finance and business assistance.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Graduated from the University of Pennsylvania in 1988, studying art history; not a degree in fashion design or business administration.
strings.facts.f2.label: Management responsibilities
strings.facts.f2.value: Serves as executive chairman and chief creative officer; a 2026 report confirms Pierre-Yves Roussel as CEO.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Brand and creative development
strings.highlights.h1.text: Started with a New York store and e-commerce in 2004 and launched Tory Sport activewear in 2015.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Supporting women entrepreneurs
strings.highlights.h2.text: The foundation offers access to capital, business education and resources, and launched the Embrace Ambition initiative.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Interview on women entrepreneurs published
strings.timeline.t1.text: Town & Country published a conversation with her about the foundation and women entrepreneurs; this is the publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: CEO succession announced
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company announced that Roussel would become CEO in early 2019, with Burch moving to executive chairman and chief creative officer.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Launches Embrace Ambition
strings.timeline.t3.text: Through her foundation, encouraged women to pursue their ambitions and challenged negative stereotypes about ambitious women.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Launches Tory Sport
strings.timeline.t4.text: Introduced an activewear collection, extending the brand's product range.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Publishes Tory Burch In Color
strings.timeline.t5.text: Her first book was published by Abrams.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Establishes her foundation
strings.timeline.t6.text: Supported women entrepreneurs in the United States through access to finance, education and resources.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founds her namesake fashion brand
strings.timeline.t7.text: Opened a boutique on New York's Elizabeth Street alongside an e-commerce website.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduates from the University of Pennsylvania
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed studies in art history; university records identify her as a member of the class of 1988.
